items.text: Cardinals trading Marvin Harrison Jr and 7th to Texans for 2027 2nd and 6th; MHJ inactive for trade.
items.why: Blockbuster confirmed with Schefter; Ryans announced postgame.
items.implication: MHJ reunites with Stroud; boosts HOU WR room, opens ARI targets for Wilson/others.
items.opportunity: Immediate WR help for Stroud/Collins; ARI depth chart reset.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery downgraded to out with groin injury.
items.implication: HOU RB committee shifts; more work for other backs.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for HOU RBs behind him.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty will play after GTD status due to plantar fasciitis/ankle.
items.why: Pregame workout cleared; Rapoport confirmed go.
items.implication: Lead RB role intact for LV.

items.text: Justin Jefferson is active vs Saints; Jordan Addison and Odell Beckham Jr inactive.
items.why: Jefferson wanted to play in Louisiana; Addison hamstring.
items.implication: Jefferson full workload expected; Addison absence concentrates targets.
items.opportunity: Higher target share for Jefferson and other MIN WRs/TEs.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins will play vs Dolphins after being listed questionable.
items.why: ETR final pregame updates; corroborated by Schefter.
items.implication: Full CIN WR corps available; no major role expansion for backups.

items.text: Patriots lost RB TreVeyon Henderson to ankle injury (and OT Will Campbell knee).
items.why: Ankle; ETR watching list; story via Reiss.
items.implication: NE RB depth thins; more for Stevenson/others next week.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for remaining NE RBs.

items.text: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel out for remainder of game due to hamstring.
items.why: Hamstring mid-game; Rapoport confirmed ruled out.
items.implication: Targets shift to remaining SF WRs/TE; monitor for next week.

items.text: Jaylen Warren should be workhorse with Rico Dowdle out; passes every test like Ekeler; coaching has refused full role previously.
items.why: Dowdle out (ETR not expected); advanced stats/eye test strong.
items.implication: High-end RB2/RB1 upside for Warren in PIT backfield.

items.text: Ladd McConkey is active but not expected to play meaningful snaps.
items.why: Foot injury; ETR had not expected.
items.implication: Minimal fantasy value; targets to others like Quentin Johnston/Tre Harris.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for LAC WR depth.

items.text: Terry McLaurin will play after GTD.
items.why: Final ETR update; Schefter listed among actives.
items.implication: WAS WR1 available with Diggs out.

items.text: Caleb Williams not expected to play (hamstring); inactive confirmed.
items.implication: CHI QB backup starts; impacts all pass-catchers.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs was best salary-adjusted value and only 61.5% owned in DK single-entry double-ups; must-play in cash.
items.why: Projections showed elite value despite high salary; low ownership for chalk.
items.implication: Strong cash/GPP play with DET offense rolling.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry share in positive game script.

items.text: Zay Flowers officially active vs Falcons.
items.implication: BAL WR1 available opposite Huntley or starter.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere.
items.why: Postgame/waiver heat after performance or opportunity.
items.implication: Priority add in GB backfield depth.
items.opportunity: Potential increased role if injuries or scheme.
